question: T10: do the rows rules hold on sequences they haven't seen? Predictions were pushed before each round was read.
answer: Round 1 tested the rule fitted to the first reads: 87 of 103 steps, predictions in commit 6647ec1. It was off at exact edges, wrong that an embed keeps 2 rows, and wrong on a fall in a block that needs more rows than it has. The rule was refit to round 1. Round 2 tested that: 98 of 98, predictions in commit 64879fc, no refit after. Rule now, inferred: height in whole pixels; N(x) = ceil((x + gap - 1) / pitch); a rise takes max(rows, N(height)); a fall leaves the block alone if N(height) >= rows, else gives up N(fall), down to 1. Same height changes nothing, and empty code changes nothing.
notRead: A null in reads is a step with no read of its own: round 1 repeated a label in mixedSteps and embedWalk, so the later read overwrote the earlier, and pulls' last two steps failed on the oracle. Heights are what the read's .sqs-code-container or .sqs-embed-container measured.
